heading: cyProviding proof of rent arrears
paragraphs: cyYou must provide proof of how rent arrears have built up over time. You can either:
bullets: cyupload a rent statement that follows the guidelines below

contentBlocks.heading: cyGuidelines for uploading a rent statement

contentBlocks.text: cyA bank statement will not be accepted. Your rent statement must show:

bullets: cyevery date when a payment was supposed to be made
cythe amount that was due on each of those dates
cythe actual payments that were made, and when they were made
cythe running total of rent arrears

contentBlocks.text: cyIt must cover the time period of either:

bullets: cyfrom the first date the defendants missed a payment
cythe last two years of payments, if the first date of their missed payment was more than two years ago
